mainImage.alt: Brian Poindexter, a union ironworker and Brook Park City Councilman, standing for a campaign photo as a candidate for Ohio's 7th Congressional District in 2026
mainImage.caption: Brook Park City Councilman Brian Poindexter, a union ironworker and apprentice instructor at Ironworkers Local 17, is one of eight Democrats challenging Republican Rep. Max Miller in Ohio's 7th Congressional District.

body.alt: Republican Rep. Max Miller, who served as a White House aide to Trump before entering Congress, speaks at a 2022 campaign rally. Miller is one of Trump's most loyal followers and is being challenged by eight Democrats including union ironworker Brian Poindexter.
